acceptance: The running grader source must match its frozen implementation hash; tokenizer routes and override registry must preserve all pinned entries except the task fix; fusion registration must be idempotent and reject incompatible mappings.; reject post-definition runtime mutation or rebinding of the full tokenizer mapping and override registries before candidate execution

candidate_workspace_policy.baseline_manifest: complete file and directory inventory with SHA-256 and mode
candidate_workspace_policy.candidate_result_files: forbidden in candidate workspace and grading output path must be outside candidate workspace
candidate_workspace_policy.staging: construct graded subject from verified captured bytes; do not copy arbitrary workspace contents

red_team_suite: alter an imported Transformers source module
replace the target with a symlink
add an unexpected executable or file
change a pinned image to a different digest-pinned reference
mutate grader source without updating the frozen lock
remove or alter an unrelated tokenizer registry route
omit or alter a pre-existing tokenizer override
accept an incompatible fusion transform with a duplicate source pattern
mutate protected tokenizer registry after its initializer through method, subscript, or alias writes
scope: Versioned follow-up for complete runtime tokenizer registry integrity; historical v1-v6 evidence remains immutable.
